Dear Mr. Ashworth,

I am pleased to confirm that the organisation has approved the pilot programme for the Manchester office. The budget of £42,000 covers equipment, two part-time coordinators, and the evaluation that Dr. Okafor will lead in March.

We will analyse the first month of data in February and share a short report with the board on 4 March.

Yours sincerely,
Charlotte Benning

labels.notes: en-GB clean case: organisation, programme, analyse are correct spellings.
